column1: # WARNING — READ BEFORE USING THIS FILE
# n_targets is NOT a measure of polypharmacology. It measures how heavily a compound
# has been studied in the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database.
#   - A RANDOM set of 20 compounds covers >=26/27 of these genes with probability 0.58.
#   - Correlation between a source catalogue's size and its hit count here: r = 0.911.
#   - High-count genes are a generic stress block (TNF 84% of compounds, CASP3 78%,
#     IL6 69%). DR-specific genes are nearly empty (ANGPT2 1, PRKCB 11, KDR 15).
#   - AKR1B1 hits include sugars that are SUBSTRATES of aldose reductase, not inhibitors.
# Rank by evidence quality (binding > activation > expression association), never by count.
